'''Margravine''', formally styled as "'''Royal Margravine''',"<ref name="FRR">''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]''</ref> was a title given to the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchs]] of [[Nallastia]] and [[Vena]]. [[Quenelle]] was the margravine of Nallastia, as well as the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Skull Queen]], in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Abominelle]] was the Margravine of Vena.
